mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE B.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND B.ACCT_TYPE = #{capacctType} AND B.CCY = #{ccy} AND B.ACCT_NO = C.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = C.CCY

SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE B.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and b.ACCT_TYPE=#{capacctType} AND B.CCY = #{ccy} AND B.ACCT_NO = C.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = C.CCY
SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM stl_fin_product_acct B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE b.ACCT_NO = c.ACCT_NO and B.FINPROD_ID = #{chlId}
SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, B.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO A, STL_CAPACCT_INFO B WHERE A.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} AND A.TRD_ACCT_ID = B.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = #{ccy}
SELECT SUM(FINISH_AMT) FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} and TRADE_ID != #{entrustId}

select close_price from ( select msp.close_price, rownum as rn from INTERF_STOCK_QUOTE msp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on msp.STOCK_COOD = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and fp.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and msp.TRADE_DATE<=#{dealDate} order by msp.TRADE_DATE desc ) where rn = 1

select close_price from ( select msp.close_price, rownum rn from MST_SHARE_PRICE msp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on msp.SHARES_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and fp.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and msp.DEAL_DATE<=#{dealDate} order by msp.DEAL_DATE desc ) where rn = 1
select eea.first_unit_cprice2 from ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea where eea.entrust_id=#{entrustId}

select fp.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT fp --标的类金融产品 inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt --金融产品分类表 on fp.finprod_id=fpt.finprod_id where fp.finprod_type2='F01' and fp.finprod_id=#{finprodId} and fp.trade_market in ('03','04') and (fpt.type_7='11' or (fpt.type_6='B13 ' and fp.finprod_market_id like '123%'))

select ftp.finprod_id from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp --交易类金融产品 inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt --金融产品分类表 on ftp.finprod_id=fpt.finprod_id and fpt.type_6='H02' where ftp.finprod_type2 in ('F02','F03') and ftp.finprod_id=#{finprodId}

select (NVL(psp.AMOUNT, 0) - NVL(pledge.AMOUNT, 0)) * 100 avaPledgePrin from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FINPROD_ID, SUM(NVL(AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND HODING_TYPE = '04' AND SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secId} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID) pledge ON pledge.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and psp.finprod_id= #{finprodId} and psp.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secId} and psp.cdate= (select max(cdate) from PTL_SEC_POSITION tt where tt.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId} and tt.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and tt.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secId})
select to_char(MAX(CDATE), 'yyyy-MM-dd') from ETR_CASH_POSITION
select to_char(MAX(CDATE), 'yyyy-MM-dd') from ETR_SEC_POSITION

if.test: !channel and (secAcctId == null or secAcctId == '') and (entrust == null || !entrust)

mapper.select: SELECT B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, B.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE*A.PLEDGE_NUMBER qty, A.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRatio, A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, A.PLEDGE_NUMBER FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT * FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW WHERE TRADE_ID = #{totleId}
SELECT * FROM ETR_CASH_POSITION_FLOW WHERE ORDER_ID like 'O'||#{totleId}||'%'

SELECT A.VDATE startDate, A.MDATE endDate, ( SELECT MIN(C.VDATE) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN C WHERE C.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID ) firstPayDate, A.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice, A.COUPON_SPECIES bondsType, E.BASIS basis,
F.INT_TYPE intRateType, G.PAY_CYCLE yearIntRate, G.CALC_RULE calMethod, H.EXERCISE_DATE nextExeDate, H.EXERCISE_PRICE nextExercisePrice FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON D.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and E.IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO F ON F.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND G.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE IN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= #{sysDate} ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} ) H ON 1=1 WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT A.CASH_TYPE_1 cashType1, B.VDATE vdate, B.MDATE mdate, B.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust, B.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust, B.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, B.INT_AMT intAmt, B.IS_PAY_INT isPayInt FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

select SEQNO, PORTFOLIO_ID, SEC_ACCT_ID, FINPROD_ID, BRANCH, INV_AIM, HODING_TYPE, CDATE, CCY, NVL(AMOUNT*-1, 0) AMOUNT, P_FINPROD_ID, TRADE_ID from PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW where TRADE_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HODING_TYPE = #{holdingType}

select SEQNO SEQNO, PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID, SEC_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, BRANCH BRANCH, INV_AIM INV_AIM, HODING_TYPE HODING_TYPE, CDATE CDATE, CCY CCY, AMOUNT*-1 AMOUNT, P_FINPROD_ID P_FINPROD_ID, TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME from ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW where TRADE_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select TRD_ACCT_ID from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO where SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId}

select sum(T.AMOUNT) AMOUNT from PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW T where TRADE_ID IN (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRADE_ID != #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT sum(T.AMOUNT) AMOUNT FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW T WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT ORDER_ID FROM stl_pay_temp_orders WHERE stl_pay_temp_orders.TRADE_ID IN (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRADE_ID != #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))

select close_price_pre from ( select msp.close_price_pre, rownum as rn from INTERF_STOCK_QUOTE msp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on msp.STOCK_COOD = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and fp.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and msp.TRADE_DATE<=#{dealDate} order by msp.TRADE_DATE desc ) where rn = 1

select pre_close_price from ( select msp.pre_close_price, rownum rn from MST_SHARE_PRICE msp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on msp.SHARES_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and fp.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and msp.DEAL_DATE<=#{dealDate} order by msp.DEAL_DATE desc ) where rn = 1
select nvl(sum(AMOUNT),0) from ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW where TRADE_ID = #{entrustId} and FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId}
